Unfortunately, this is a console port and the controls are directly taken from console. Using mouse and keyboard was too disorienting so I had to refund this. Using a game controller worked better, but with it you lose the needed mouse precision and feel for this to be a proper shooter where aiming would matter. Shame as I was planning on playing the game as co-op with my friends and it had some real potential. I really hope the developers make a better PC port and update the controls at some point. First person view would be nice :)
Great game, that is even better with friends.

This game is actually fun and making some fun builds with weapons and core modules that change your loadout. It's a good ass game, but the major thing about it that hurts the most is the fact that the game is kinda dead? I can't really tell since I get people but some articles and posts suggest that the network code is kinda buggy as hell, making it more of a Play-With-Friends game. Private games are the only ones that seem playable and trying to connect to someone's lobby with a mission you want just puts you back to single player. And you can't even get into a game mid-match, gotta be from beginning to end, which does suggest that the matchmaking code singles out those starting a match. The only way to properly play the game alone with randoms is by going through Quickplay which doesn't boot you out as soon as you load in the lobby. 

So right now, just wait on this game for the most part due to the matchmaking issues, or get the game with a dedicated group that want to check this game out. A small tip on that though, it will kick you to the player home area if you have the lobby settings set to public. Make sure you play on a private lobby and everything will go smoothly. I suggest this awesomely fun and complex L4D clone.
